name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - Dawn
description:
Bright, clean, and smooth from the first pull. The Rocket Blast Dawn cartridge holds 1 gram of premium distillate in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery — simple, reliable, and made to last.

Dawn brings a fresh, easygoing flavor: soft citrus and light floral notes with a crisp, subtly sweet finish. It's a clean, mellow profile made for smooth, uncomplicated sessions — an easy pick when you want something light and refreshing.

Why you'll love it:

1G of premium distillate — smooth, potent, and consistent
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Dawn flavor — soft citrus and light floral notes with a crisp finish
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Clean flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast Dawn is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
